note: All device-report scenarios (2-4) are gated on a connected SuperMUTT HID device. With no hardware present, the UWP sample hides the SuperMuttScenario panel and shows a not-connected status; a faithful WinUI 3 migration must do the same. Behavioral actuation of gated controls is not possible in either app without hardware, so parity is judged on structural presence + the correct hardware-gated fallback.

features.title: Connecting To Device
features.expected: Connect/Disconnect buttons, device list, status 'No devices currently selected'.

features.title: Feature Reports
features.expected: Without device: 'Device is not connected' fallback; controls hidden until a device connects (matches UWP).
